correctness.rationale: Legendre/Kummer implies exactly 2s_2(n)-s_2(3n) because 2n+1 is odd. The transfer matrix enumerates every input bit and terminal carry; exact inversion yields numerator (1+z)(1-uz) and denominator 1-(1+u)z-(1-u+u^2)z^2+(u+u^2)z^3. Binary forbidden-pattern counts prove both extremal Fibonacci frequencies. Differentiation proves exact means at all L, and the characteristic cubic has simple eigenvalue 2 with derivatives lambda_u=1, lambda_uu=4/3, giving Gaussian variance 11/12. Standalone verifier checks 120 exact integers, 8191 factorial-valued index evaluations, 13 histograms, 24 recurrences, and 13 first-moment/edge assertions. Limits: finite tests are not infinite proof; the analytic eigenvalue argument supplies the actual CLT.

value.rationale: Exact frequencies of every two-adic valuation in all initial dyadic families of ternary-tree counts form a natural unbounded parameter classification. The rational generating denominator, exact block mean, sharp Fibonacci maximum multiplicity and nontrivial Gaussian variance describe global divisibility that is not supplied by the classical pointwise carry formula or a tiny enumeration. The future comparison to other Fuss-Catalan orders and digital multiply-by-three statistics is motivated but not claimed as an established theorem.
